title: Senior Software Engineer, Computer Vision Platform (m/f/d)
searchText: Senior Software Engineer, Computer Vision Platform (m/f/d) Sportradar Company Description We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description ABOUT US: We are looking for an Senior Software Engineer to join the engineering team working on Sportradar's Argos platform, our cloud-native, low latency infrastructure for computer vision processing. As a Senior Software Engineer within Sportradar's AI unit, you will work with an experienced team of data scientists, developers and dev-ops engineers building innovative infrastructure solutions for computer vision, machine learning and data analytics workloads. Computer vision is rapidly becoming one of the core technologies powering sports data collection across Sportradar’s products for sports media, sports betting and coaching. Sportradar is a global leader in understanding and leveraging the power of sports data for hundreds of business customers around the world, in turn entertaining millions of sports enthusiasts. THE CHALLENGE: Research, design, development, deployment and day-to-day operations of solutions for real-time, low latency computer vision processing hosted in AWS cloud. Collaborate and support our team of computer vision researchers with the integration and productization of computer vision models. Contribute to the evolution of our technology stack and technical architectures powering computer vision and AI workloads, as part of a growing team of talented developers, data scientists, data engineers already dedicated to this mission. Mentor engineers and lead code/design reviews. Optimize system reliability and performance. ABOUT YOU: Advanced knowledge of programming . Strong expertise in Python with demonstrable hands-on experience developing production grade solutions. Deep experience with containers and container orchestration frameworks (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong understanding of system observability and reliabilit y. Must be comfortable with modern software development methodologies such as agile development, git, CI/CD, code review, etc.. Must be comfortable with using AI coding tools and agentic technologies. Bonus : Experience with development in Golang and/or Java. Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes Operators. Bonus : Demonstrated experience with productization of CV/ML models. Bonus : Understanding of machine learning / deep learning concepts and some hands on experience with machine learning or computer vision using deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Keras, Tensorflow, MXNet). Bonus : DevOps experience (hands-on experience with the design, set-up and administration of infrastructure) and with cloud services like AWS/Azure. Bachelor of Science in Computer Science / Engineering, Mathematics / Statistics, or related field; equivalent experience acceptable. Fluent in English (written and spoken). Minimum 5 years of software development experience . Demonstrable experience with developing and running production-grade software solutions . Autonomous, rigorous, creative and a team playe r. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community , including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme . Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos . Flexible working hours . While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a hybrid model, with team members working in the office three days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two Technical Interviews: Meet with the Technical team and later with the Hiring Manager to dive into your solution, as also discuss team fit. Onsite Interview : Meet with the local team and take a tour of our office for a final meet-and-greet. Finals Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! Qualifications Additional Information At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!
